## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

Reviewed a component-library change that adds a `height` input (`"constrained" | "auto"`) to `bit-accordion`, replacing the hardcoded `tw-max-h-80 tw-overflow-y-auto` on the content panel with conditional class bindings. The default is `"constrained"`, so the three existing consumers (`onboarding.component.html`, `shared-folder-card-grid.component.html`, and the accordion stories) keep their current rendering — this is additive and non-breaking. Both Tailwind classes appear as literal strings in the template, so the JIT scanner still emits them, and `tw-min-h-0` is retained so the grid-rows collapse animation continues to work. The MDX documents the trade-off that `height="auto"` does not scroll, and a matching `AutoHeight` story follows the existing `render`-only story pattern in this file.
